_source: 🔴 THE SOURCE EXISTS AND COWORK DID NOT KNOW IT. Keith, 2026-08-12: 'there's an icon in the sys tray. Backclick gives usage.' This meter sat at ONE 2026-07-12 sample for 31 days, and the reason recorded for that was 'Cowork cannot read its own spend - no ledger, no API, the figure lives in Keith's account UI.' That was TRUE about the API and WRONG about the world: the number was two clicks away on his own desktop. ⇒ 'I cannot measure this' is a claim about the instruments SEARCHED, not about the ones that exist. Ask the human who owns the machine.
_reading: 2026-08-11: 3% of the week. 2026-08-12 (during this session): 6%. THE SESSION DOUBLED THE WEEK'S CONSUMPTION. Recorded because it is the evidence for C-13: the reasoning trail is not free.
_rate: 3 readings, 3 consecutive days: 08-11 3% · 08-12 6% · 08-13 9%. LINEAR AT +3 POINTS/DAY. Two intervals is a rate, not a trend - do not extrapolate a week from it, and note the whole span is ONE long plumbing session, which is not a typical workload.
